feedback: You created and exported a class named CounterApp, which is good. However, the class has parentheses after its name (CounterApp()), which is incorrect syntax for a class definition. Also, the @Component decorator is missing, which is required for Angular components.
hint: Remove the parentheses after CounterApp and add @Component() decorator above the class.
errors: Class definition syntax is incorrect (CounterApp() should be CounterApp)
